image_description: A rear-view photograph of a person wearing a long, voluminous, platinum blonde curly wig. The hair cascades down the back in tight ringlets and loose waves. A portion of the subject's shoulder and upper back is visible, wearing a light-colored garment with faint patterns. A watermark '2dehands.nl' is present in the bottom right corner.
